text:
lana-docs: Heads-up: I opened a small PR to fix an outdated trace snippet in the Console "observability" examples. The code still references `tracekey` and one playground link 404s. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/8291
jess-eng: On it. Do you want the snippet replaced inline or should I add a new example with `traceId`?
lana-docs: Replace inline please, keep the older example behind a short note about legacy routing. Also update the screenshot alt text if label changes.
omar-ml: Important: runtime now surfaces `traceId` (kebab->camel rename) in hosted responses. Docs should match SDKs to avoid confusion.
kevin-sdk: I'll update Node + Py snippets to consume `traceId`. Suggest a minimal example for tracehook attach: `tracehook.record({ traceId: payload.traceId, tokens: payload.tokens })`
maya-ux: UX note: the panel title currently reads "Cost by tracekey" which is awkward. Recommend "Cost by trace ID" and use sentence case in alt text. If we change UI copy, include the exact string in the screenshot caption.
jess-eng: Pushed a commit replacing `tracekey` -> `traceId`, updated code fences and the preset link. Left a TODO near the playground sample referencing the broken link.
ci-bot: CI checks for PR #8291: links: 4 passed, 1 failed (playground/examples.md line 103).
lana-docs: I'll sweep that playground example and drop in the canonical presets URL. Also adding a short migration note saying older SDKs may still show `tracekey` for a few weeks.
kevin-sdk: Follow-up commit with SDK snippets (node & python) pushed to branch. Node example: `// attach trace id
tracehook.record({ traceId: payload.traceId, cost_usd: payload.estimated_cost_usd })` Python example mirrors that.
maya-ux: Copy tweak: prefer "estimated cost" over `cost_usd` in human-facing text. Keep the code fields snake_case if that's idiomatic in Python.
omar-ml: One more: ensure the telemetry shape in the code samples matches the runtime's shape: `estimated_cost_usd` vs `estimated_cost` — we standardized on `_usd` in the latest API.
jess-eng: Adjusted code to use `estimated_cost_usd`. Pushed commit. Re-ran link-checker locally; playground link replaced.
ci-bot: CI for PR #8291 now: all checks passed.
lana-docs: Merged. Thanks all! Leaving thread open for any downstream owners who need to mirror the change in other guides. :thumbsup:
